discount_code_value.name: discount_code_value
discount_code_value.value:
("discount_code"."kind" = 'percent' and "discount_code"."rate_bp" between 1 and 10000)
        or ("discount_code"."kind" = 'amount' and "discount_code"."amount_minor" > 0 and "discount_code"."currency" is not null)

sale_charge_kind.name: sale_charge_kind
sale_charge_kind.value:
("sale_charge"."kind" = 'percent' and "sale_charge"."rate_bp" between 1 and 10000)
        or ("sale_charge"."kind" = 'fixed' and "sale_charge"."amount_minor" >= 0 and "sale_charge"."currency" is not null)

document_rate_all_or_none.name: document_rate_all_or_none
document_rate_all_or_none.value: ("document"."rate_base" is null) = ("document"."rate_quote" is null) and ("document"."rate_quote" is null) = ("document"."rate_value" is null)

payment_rate_all_or_none.name: payment_rate_all_or_none
payment_rate_all_or_none.value: ("payment"."rate_base" is null) = ("payment"."rate_quote" is null) and ("payment"."rate_quote" is null) = ("payment"."rate_value" is null)

quote_discount.name: quote_discount
quote_discount.value:
("quote"."discount_kind" is null and "quote"."discount_value" is null)
        or ("quote"."discount_kind" is not null and "quote"."discount_value" > 0)
